sup:70740.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: part:370010 – proposal for a 36-month package from 2027
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your quotation. We would like to continue working with Werdenfels and agree a longer-term package your team can approve.

We propose EUR 4.60/kg for part:370010, payment within 30 days net and a 36-month contract, with AS-14404 on a 45% material share, 0% deadband and base month 2026-08. The requirement remains 23,700 kg/year, DAP, 14-day lead time, effective 2027-01-01, with no tooling charges.

Our purchase orders with you for part:370010 on 2 and 17 June 2026 were at EUR 5.26/kg (po:4500014022-10, po:4500014078-10), compared with EUR 5.84/kg on 1 and 18 September 2026 (po:4500014355-10, po:4500014427-10).

We recognise the cost pressures you described. Could you review the starting price alongside the longer commitment and adjustment mechanism? Your August review noted committee approval for price changes above 2% (doc:20260812-70740-M3). Please involve the colleague who can approve the complete package from the outset and let us have a binding counterproposal. A 24-month term would also be possible.

Thank you for considering it.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
move.body:
Thank you for working through the options with us. We appreciate your team's careful review and would like to find an arrangement that works for Werdenfels as well as for us.

For your review, PPI-C2431 changed by -2.27% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08). We recognise that this recent movement can coexist with the annual increase you described. Could you take it into account when reviewing the starting price?

Could you kindly consider one of these complete alternatives? Each price is conditional on its payment term and adjustment clause.

Option A: EUR 5.07/kg, payment within 30 days net, a 36-month contract, AS-14404 on a 45% material share, 5% deadband and base month 2026-08.
Option B: EUR 5.05/kg, payment within 14 days net, a 36-month contract, AS-14404 on a 45% material share, 5% deadband and base month 2026-08.
Option C: EUR 5.10/kg, payment within 60 days net, a 36-month contract, AS-14404 on a 45% material share, 5% deadband and base month 2026-08.

The fixed terms of our enquiry remain unchanged. These are new proposals for your approval. Could you issue the option you can approve as your binding offer? If none works, which term would need to change? We would be pleased to review it together.

Kind regards,
Purchasing

move.subject: part:370010 – building on your 14-day structure
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your revised offer and for moving to EUR 5.20/kg with 14-day payment. We appreciate the step and your flexibility on the payment terms.

Building on the structure you proposed, we would like to ask your team to approve EUR 5.05/kg, payment within 14 days net, a 36-month contract, AS-14404 on a 45% material share, 5% deadband and base month 2026-08. The fixed terms of our enquiry remain unchanged. This is a new proposal for your approval, not an agreed position.

On the alloy component, AS-14404 changed by -5.49% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09). We recognise that this recent window can coexist with the annual increase you described. The AS-14404 clause would also adjust the price if the series moves beyond the deadband during the contract.

Could the colleague authorised to approve the complete package issue it as your binding offer? If a specific term stands in the way, please tell us which one, and we will gladly review it with you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.subject: part:370010 – your EUR 5.10/kg offer: one remaining term
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your offer and for the move to EUR 5.10/kg. We appreciate the step your team has taken.

We can work with your EUR 5.10/kg price, the 36-month term and the AS-14404 clause on a 45% material share, 5% deadband and base month 2026-08. The one term we would need changed is payment: 60 days net instead of 14 days. We understand this is a request to change your final offer, not an agreed position, and the fixed terms of our enquiry remain unchanged.

If the colleague authorised to approve the complete package can confirm it, please issue it as your binding offer and we will conclude on that basis.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
